response.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award GROUP BY player_id), award_total AS (SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count FROM award_counts) SELECT p.player_id, COALESCE(ac.award_count, 0) AS award_count, CAST(COALESCE(ac.award_count, 0) AS REAL) / t.total_count AS fraction FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN award_counts AS ac ON ac.player_id = p.player_id CROSS JOIN award_total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
